evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~6-9 ppm to 24.3 ppm
Tube pressure drifting up from ~3.01 to 3.21 Torr at constant Ar setpoint
Ar flow steady at setpoint (~100 sccm), so pressure rise is not from flow change

args.missing_evidence: Continued O2/pressure trend, and a leak-check (e.g., isolate flow / pump-down rate-of-rise) to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction
